_comment: Hand-built reference for the cream Comfee microwave. 'button_xy' is the
START/+30SEC button center read off the grid overlay by eye, in the
coordinates of 'image' (960x540 work frame). 'crop' bounds the control
panel and is chosen to include the dial, the WGT./TIME/MENU text and the
printed button labels -- the cream finish is nearly textureless, so the
printed text is carrying most of the SIFT features.
Source: frame 207 of 2C3103B0-...MP4, the sharpest frame in the clip
(Laplacian variance 878). Held out of the eval set by extract_frames.py.
10 to 13. The original was read off a 50px grid at work resolution and sat 3px
left and 7px high of the chrome dome's centre. Because EVERY prediction is this
mark carried through the fitted transform, that offset appeared in every frame
of the output -- it was spotted by eye on the overlay video, not by any score.
2026-09-21: button_xy re-measured from (460,386) to (467.5,389.5). The original
was read off a 50px grid at work resolution and sat up and to the left of the
button; the offset showed in EVERY frame of the overlay video, because every
prediction is this one mark carried through the fitted transform.
It was measured by fitting a circle (HoughCircles, narrow radius band) to the
button on the 4K source, not by eye. Two successive by-eye readings of this
same mark disagreed with each other and both disagreed with the fit -- one of
them overcorrected past the centre. This is the single most leveraged number in
the whole detector, so it should not be eyeballed. The fit also independently
located the STOP/ECO button 32px to its left, which is the expected spacing.
